scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof covers all dimensions, lengths and dilations. Finite executable checks corroborate but do not replace it. External novelty is best-knowledge provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only integral affine unimodular parallelepipeds and positive integer dilations are covered.
The universal Borsuk upper bound and the general clique property of diameter graphs are prior results.
The independent mathematical audit and definitive historical-priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Exact lattice-diameter graphs and counting polynomials of unimodular boxes
